commands.handoffDesc: Compact context and switch this chat to another provider

settings.defaultBackendHint: Initial provider used when starting a new Switchable conversation.
settings.transportHint: Auto uses the fast direct Anthropic-compatible API (~1s) and falls back to structured local compaction.
settings.compactorModelHint: Used when calling the direct API. deepseek-chat is fastest on DeepSeek endpoints.
settings.keepRecentTurnsHint: Keep the newest user turns intact alongside the compacted earlier summary.
settings.archiveSourceHint: Automatically archive the original native chat after migrating to another provider.
